$description: Agentic Design System default tokens, generated from the shared Foundation resolver by tools/generate_tokens.py - do not hand-edit, regenerate instead. Follows the Design Tokens Community Group Format Module, version 2025.10 (https://tr.designtokens.org/format/2025.10/) - a Community Group specification, not a W3C Recommendation. Colors and shadows use typed sRGB/composite objects; dimension/duration values are typed {value, unit} objects per spec, not raw CSS strings; a token whose source is a CSS var() reference to another token is emitted as a DTCG alias ({group.key}) instead of a repeated literal. Tokens that differ between themes carry both values under $extensions['com.agentic-design-system.mode']; $value is always the dark-theme (default) value.

com.agentic-design-system.context.liveExport: Export Foundation JSON includes current saved or preview settings; this published artifact represents default settings.
